loadingNeed.basis: 2 truck loading bays for 1,457 m² of floor. The Parking By-law calls this size Class B, its mid-size bay: 10.2 × 3.4 m with 3.8 m clearance (Class C is the 23.1 m bay for the largest trucks). The count uses row 5.2.5: the by-law does not name data centres, but the City classes them as a Transportation and Storage use (RTS 19744), which row 5.2.5 lists. Each bay is reached by a 6.1 m aisle (s. 5.4.1).

s.src: Air-cooled chillers with free-cooling coils (air cooling): an air-cooled hall needs chilled water at about 13 °C or warmer (NREL for DOE FEMP, Best Practices Guide 2024, s. 5.2.1), and a dry cooler cannot cool water below the outdoor air (rated units leave it 3–11 K above), so chillers carry the full load in summer. Basis unit: Vertiv Liebert AFC FIZ135, 12.14 × 2.36 m, 2.90 m high, 1,489 kW at 35 °C ambient, 27.8 → 18.9 °C fluid, 30% glycol, with oversized free-cooling coils (Vertiv SL-71060 R09/24, "Preliminary data"; manufacturer claim).
